g.text: DeepEP low-latency dispatch: what GPU 0 receives
T = 8 is the worst case for one expert: all 4 + 4 tokens
that the 2 GPUs may send pick the same expert.
Row order inside an expert is DeepEP's choice;
the kernels only use the count.
Expert e owns rows [0, masked_m[e]) of its T rows. The other rows are not written by dispatch,
and every later buffer (gateup, q, down) keeps the same rows. GPU 1 receives e2, e3 the same way.
DSV4-Flash, 4 x B200, b = 64 per GPU
